ValidationRule.description: Bloquea lineas nuevas a credito si el sell supera el saldo del cliente. Solo compara con moneda de linea = moneda de cuenta: las formulas no convierten divisas y cruzarlas daba falsos sin-credito (linea MXN vs saldo USD).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Shipment__r.Account_for__r.Venta_Sap__c , "Credito"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Service_Rate_Name__r.Fee_Category__c , 'Road Freights'), ISPICKVAL( Service_Rate_Name__r.Fee_Category__c , 'Sea Freights'), ISPICKVAL( Service_Rate_Name__r.Fee_Category__c , 'Air Freights') ), TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = TEXT(Shipment__r.Account_for__r.CurrencyIsoCode), Shipment_Sell_Price__c > Shipment__r.Account_for__r.Saldo_DisponibleOK__c , isnew() )
